source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    def rotate_cw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    def rotate_ccw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    def rotate_180(a):
        return [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    cw = rotate_cw(grid)
    ccw = rotate_ccw(grid)
    half = [list(grid[i]) + cw[i] for i in range(n)]
    lower = [ccw[i] + rotate_180(grid)[i] for i in range(n)]
    return half + lower
